info.name: Contract Management API
info.description: API and Nginx gateway checks for Contract Management. Select the Local or Production Postman environment, then run Login first to populate that environment's token. User accounts are created only by administrators through User Management. Download-only security: grant + authenticated download, rotating cookie sessions and Admin security settings. Access tokens expire; Refresh uses the Postman cookie jar and X-Refresh-CSRF. All structured bodies are JSON.

item.name: Create Contract - إضافة عقد
item.description: Reference-based procurement entry at /contracts/create. Login as Admin/Contracts to create, update or delete. Dean/Planning/Finance are read-only by default. Failed status clears announcement dates, bid minutes and wishes while retaining the reminder and core texts. Every structured request body is JSON.

exec: const doc = pm.response.json().data; if (doc?.id) pm.environment.set('contract_request_id', doc.id);
pm.test('Reminder and ordered minutes persist', () => { pm.expect(doc.reminderDate).to.eql('2026-11-03'); pm.expect(doc.bids).to.have.lengthOf(1); });
pm.test('Success filter works', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.response.json().data.forEach(doc => pm.expect(doc.status).to.eql('success')); });

const doc = pm.response.json().data; pm.test('Dependent fields clear, reminder remains', () => { pm.expect(doc.announceStart).to.eql(null); pm.expect(doc.announceEnd).to.eql(null); pm.expect(doc.bids).to.eql([]); pm.expect(doc.wishes).to.eql([]); pm.expect(doc.reminderDate).to.eql('2026-11-03'); });

request.description: Deletes the record selected by contract_request_id. Run Create first when testing.

item.name: Doctoral Contracts - عقد الدكتوراه
item.description: Available below Educational Content. Admin/Contracts can create/update; seeded reader roles can list/read/download. File downloads require the existing single-use grant. Enter a document in the multipart request before running it; JSON creation may omit the attachment.

exec: const grant = pm.response.json().data?.grant; if (grant) pm.environment.set('download_grant', grant);

item.name: Planning - Cost table display
item.description: Planning includes costTable for each visible agreement. paymentMethod=text displays paymentText. paymentMethod=table opens the selected agreement's years/percentage/details rows. Legacy dated payment schedules remain available without conversion.

exec: pm.test('Per-document cost tables and visibility', () => pm.response.json().data.forEach(item => { pm.expect(item.isHidden).to.eql(false); pm.expect(item.costTable).to.be.an('array'); }));

item.name: Secure Downloads and Security Settings
item.description: Run Login first. Choose finance_agreement_type/id, order id and download_scope. Read and Download permissions are both required. A grant is session-bound and single-use, default 60 seconds. Keep Postman cookies enabled. No preview or public media URLs are supported.

item.name: Reject reused grant (run immediately after download)
Agreements - Related Finance order viewer
item.description: Agreement list responses include orderCount for active files only. All agreement, Planning, Finance and Dean list endpoints accept hasOrders=true or hasOrders=false. These read endpoints reuse finance_agreement_type/id and disbursement_order_id. scope=agreement requires read access to that agreement type; scope=planning requires Planning read and a visible agreement; scope=dean or finance requires that feature's read permission. These endpoints never grant upload, replacement or deletion access.

item.name: List Nafath agreements with Finance orders

exec: pm.test('Only agreements with orders', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.every(item => item.orderCount > 0)).to.eql(true); });

item.name: List Nafath agreements without Finance orders

exec: pm.test('Only agreements without orders', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.every(item => item.orderCount === 0)).to.eql(true); });

item.name: List visible Planning agreements with orders

exec: pm.test('Planning visibility and order filter', () => { pm.response.to.have.status(200); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.every(item => !item.isHidden && item.orderCount > 0)).to.eql(true); });

request.description: Requires a fresh grant from Secure Downloads with matching document, order and scope. Direct calls without a grant return 403.

item.name: Dashboard - Role and permission scoped metrics
item.description: Login as each role, then request the dashboard. Home read permission is required. Planning excludes hidden agreements. Finance metrics require Finance or Dean access. User counts are aggregate-only for Dean; user management remains Admin-only. No sample metrics are generated.

exec: pm.test('Counts are numeric and months are bounded', () => { pm.expect(dashboard.agreements.total).to.be.a('number'); pm.expect(dashboard.charts.monthly).to.have.lengthOf(6); });

item.name: Dean - Agreement review and Planning visibility
item.description: Login as Admin or Dean. Dean read permission lists every agreement, including hidden records, and reads details and Finance order files. Dean write permission changes only Planning visibility. Showing or hiding a document changes the next Planning list response. List and detail requests select the first available document and order; choose another ID as needed.

exec: const first = pm.response.json().data?.[0]; if (first) { pm.environment.set('dean_agreement_type', first.feature); pm.environment.set('dean_agreement_id', first.id); }

item.name: Read agreement details and active Finance orders

exec: const first = pm.response.json().data?.orders?.[0]; if (first) pm.environment.set('dean_order_id', first.id);

item.name: Download Finance order with Dean permission

request.description: Requires a fresh grant from Secure Downloads with matching document, order and scope. Direct calls without a grant return 403.

item.name: Finance - Disbursement orders
item.description: Finance read permission lists agreements and downloads files. Finance write permission adds, replaces, or removes orders. Select actual files in multipart requests; do not manually set Content-Type. Hidden agreements remain available to Finance.

exec: const first = pm.response.json().data?.[0]; if (first) { pm.environment.set('finance_agreement_type', first.feature); pm.environment.set('finance_agreement_id', first.id); }

item.name: Upload one or more disbursement orders

request.description: Select one or multiple files under files. Up to 20 files / 19 MiB total; PDF, PNG, JPG, JPEG, DOC, DOCX, XLS, XLSX, TXT.

item.name: Edit selected order name and notes

request.description: Replaces this order's file, retaining its ID. Other orders are unchanged.
